_comment: How much of each naver dataset a run walks (contracts/entrypoints.md: 'scope.lock의 변형: 파일 하나, CHANGELOG 의무 없음, 테스트는 상수=파일 일치만 검사', #7의 collectors/commerce/scope.json과 같은 형태). datalab.window_start is Search Trend's earliest useful year (architect/slice-suncare's 10-year pull starts 2016); datalab puts the one global anchor group (anchor, the groupName the vendor echoes back; anchor_terms is what it actually searches, #90/#250) into every request and packs category_groups_per_request of that category's own groups beside it, so a request holds max_groups_per_request groups in all -- the vendor's documented cap -- and a category with more groups than that takes one request per full batch. blog.pages_max keeps one run's request spend bounded per query term -- natural-key upsert on post_id makes a shorter walk safe to widen later without a migration.

http._comment: The live transport (#182). Every attempt is charged to max_requests_per_run, retries included: a retry is another request NAVER serves. retry_backoff_s doubles at each step (2s, then 4s), and retry_max_attempts counts the first attempt.
